generator.params.bloom_area.note: The leaf area its `bloom` look draws on an organ 1 m long (visual forms Skill 2, 2026-10-14; plantc atlas), so it shades with what it shows: the flower now takes its family's flower plan from Simpson and Floral Diagrams (before, 0.639), and since 2026-10-16 its family's two carpels and its order's regular flowers (before, 0.031).

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Populus tremuloides: grows 30 m to 35 m tall.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Populus tremuloides: leaves 3 cm to 5 cm long.

traits.wood_modulus_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, Aspen, quaking, green: modulus of elasticity 5,900 MPa in static bending (clear wood, centre-loaded, span 14 depths; specific gravity 0.35). Table 4-1 gives one row for aspen, quaking and bigtooth together.

traits.wood_rupture_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, Aspen, quaking, green: modulus of rupture 35,000 kPa (clear wood in static bending). Table 4-1 gives one row for aspen, quaking and bigtooth together.

traits.wood_moisture_green_share.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 4-1, Aspen, quaking: average moisture content of green wood, heartwood 95% and sapwood 113% of oven-dry mass; stated as a share, the range between them with its middle typical where both are given. Table 4-1 gives one row for aspen, quaking and bigtooth together.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Populus tremuloides (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.41 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 516 records in 7 sources); trunks 0.41, branches 0.44. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

generator.params.path_half.note: A choice of the model's (crown form step B, broadleaf revision 11): the wood from the base at which a shoot's nodes are half as long, fitted so the plant grows to the height of its oldest reference size, with the crown's width left to grow inside the loose region.

generator.params.pipe_tip.note: A choice of the model's (crown form step B): the twig's and the leaf's pipe radii are scaled together so the stem's diameter at breast height matches the oldest reference size; the fuller crowns of broadleaf revision 11 carry more leaf, so the yearly rings (pipe_rings) are fitted near zero and the pipe model sets the diameter.

traits.juvenile_period_years.note: FEIS (Howard 1996, read): quaking aspen first flowers at 2 to 3 years; large seed crops from 10 to 20. It sets adult_age through the rule at the seed plants (spec rework P6), in place of broadleaf's default of 4 years.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a slender, clonal tree with a narrow crown and small, round, finely toothed leaves on flattened stalks. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 15 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaves; smooth, chalky white bark with dark scars. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth whitish bark with dark marks and lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Leaf families (plant roadmap P4, `families`): sun leaves somewhat smaller and narrower than shade leaves; set from general knowledge of sun and shade leaves and juvenile foliage, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
